probe: filmed by hand: the step window shows and says each step and waits for you (say next / go / done, or Right Shift + 9); the clip ends after the last one. No game sound in the video: the spoken steps come out of the speakers the recorder listens to
steps: vsShot ui dur=0 max=900 hand=1 keep=FS25_AutoDrive help=0
title: AutoDrive Add-On
kicker: Farming Simulator 25 mod: more jobs for AutoDrive

hand.do: Get in a truck or a tractor with a trailer
Left Alt + Numpad 0 to show the AutoDrive HUD, middle mouse for the cursor

caption.heading: A bar on AutoDrive
caption.text: The green ADAddOn bar sits on top of the AutoDrive HUD.

hand.do: Open the ADAddOn mode menu, slowly hover the modes

caption.heading: Six jobs
caption.text: Fill robots, milk transport, bale collection, top it off, refuel and repair.

hand.do: Pick Top It Off and click ON

caption.heading: Top It Off
caption.text: Loads until the trailer is really full, then delivers.

hand.do: If you have targets set: start AutoDrive (Pickup and Deliver)

caption.heading: Then AutoDrive drives
caption.text: The job ends by itself and the button goes back to OFF.

hand.do: Middle mouse to hide the cursor; done
